scope: 100 fixed test items per benchmark; subset scores, not full benchmark scores

math.evaluation_scope: Fixed English GSM8K test subset; not full benchmark leaderboard score
math.scoring: Strict generated final numeric answer; invalid and truncated retained; no retries; post-EOS returned padding removed.

reading-logic.authorization: User requested a quick paired run of RACE, GSM8K and LogiQA2.0 for original and EVO Qwen3.5-4B.
reading-logic.evaluation_scope: Fixed English test subsets; not full benchmark leaderboard scores
reading-logic.scoring: Strict generated final answers. Invalid and length-limited answers remain in denominator. No retries.
reading-logic.secondary_metric: MCQ first_token_forced_letter_accuracy: read-only first-forward A/B/C/D logits; not official full-answer likelihood scoring; no extra forward or constrained generation.

superseded_serial_math_attempt.reason: Measured 46-56 seconds per math pair; preserve all output, rerun same fixed 100 items with validated batching; no sample/dose/token-budget selection.

rules.change_reason: Restore omitted optional currency formatting symmetrically for both arms; all other extraction and scoring rules are unchanged. Preserve the v1 report and its hash.
rules.purpose: Symmetric diagnostic of explicit answers despite extra prose; does not replace strict_generated_accuracy.
rules.mcq: First nonempty line must contain only A-D (optional parentheses/Markdown/terminal punctuation), or an explicit [the] [correct/final] answer is/: [option/choice] A-D marker. A marked letter must end or have punctuation/newline/because/since after it. Arbitrary prose letters and option mentions are ignored.
rules.gsm8k: Entirely numeric response, explicit #### number, boxed{number}, or [the] [correct/final] answer is/: number. Allow an optional $/£/€/¥/₹/₩/₽ currency symbol and whitespace before each explicit number. Signed decimal numbers and properly grouped thousands only; normalize using Decimal; no arbitrary last-number extraction.
rules.conflicts: All recognized explicit candidates must agree after normalization; otherwise invalid. No target-aware selection. Unrecognized/malformed claims may be missed: this is a syntactic diagnostic, not semantic adjudication.
rules.markdown: Ignore paired bold/italic/backtick delimiters around tokens; no changes to the underlying answers.
rules.denominator: All 100 fixed items per benchmark, both arms, including invalid and truncated answers; all 300 pairs must be completed before this script writes a report.
rules.truncation: An explicit answer before truncation can count in this diagnostic; truncation is separately retained and reported.
rules.author_gsm8k_reference: Separate reference: first match of #### (\-?[0-9\.\,]+), strip whitespace and commas, then string equality. No Decimal normalization, no conflict rejection. The target comes from the original GSM8K source answer.
